item.title: Best Share House Suburbs Under $200/pw in Melbourne (2026)
item.description:
Best Share House Suburbs Under $200/pw in Melbourne

Finding a share house room under $200 per week in Melbourne in 2026 requires either compromise or strategy. The inner suburbs that everyone wants to live in — Fitzroy, Collingwood, Richmond — have pushed well past that mark. But there are suburbs where $200/pw gets you a decent room in a functional house, with reasonable access to the city and your campus.

item.title: How to Find a Share House in Melbourne (2026 Guide)
item.description:
How to Find a Share House in Melbourne

Finding a share house in Melbourne in 2026 is a competitive sport. Good rooms in decent suburbs go within 24-48 hours of being posted, and inspections often feel more like auditions than property viewings. The people already living in the house are choosing you as much as you’re choosing them.

This guide covers where to look, how to present yourself, what to check at inspections, and how to avoid the scams and dud situations that waste your time and money.
